stage: Implement a single revised candidate; actual candidate render and acceptance pending
lesson: Keeping every original active point immutable preserved the original peripheral gradient. Actual native images showed inadequate response at the principal crease, despite a functioning inactive exterior extension. Protection must follow the lip core and contact meaning, not the broad original active list.
hypothesis: Redistribute only the original pucker x displacement in peripheral skin, including peripheral active points, while preserving the true lip core, contact trajectories, oral tissues and central mouth. A smoother peripheral displacement field can reduce the abrupt corner shear without reducing the source pucker action.

construction.domain: Original full indexed native rest surface, same-side eligible exterior skin. Preserve original anatomy labels and topology.
construction.protected: Original top.lips (red>.025), native rim samples and original 49 contact-pair slots, oral/negative-v tissue, native rail lip-body approximation abs(u)<=1 and 0<=v<=1.05, one original indexed neighbor ring around the protected lip domain, and central abs(u)<=.64. Pair slots are not assumed to contain 98 distinct vertex IDs.
construction.coreReason: The fixed Xl rail interpolation clamps beyond its endpoints. L5 v uses a 1mm minimum denominator, so v alone is not a tissue label and v=1 need not exactly equal the outer rail at narrow corners. Original red soft edges extend to negative v and v=1.04; native lip/rim membership is protected together with the bounded rail approximation. Do not lock peripheral red=0 points at abs(u) around1.21 merely because v is below1.
construction.field: A positive-weight screened graph smoothing of the current original native pucker x contribution, with protected and domain-exterior values fixed. Preserve a native-value term so the periphery does not become a single rigid patch.
construction.scaleMeaning: Engineering smoothing length, not a hard 4mm support boundary from the lip core and not a measured tissue modulus.
construction.boundary: Existing continuous exterior and lateral guards return the correction to the original field; the domain extends beyond the original abs(u)=1.25 hard cutoff.
construction.solver: Diagonal-preconditioned conjugate gradients on the equivalent symmetric positive definite system; at most512 iterations; actual residual is recomputed after each iteration and any roundoff bounding. Require normalized local residual<=0.0001mm and relative L2 residual<=0.000001. These are algebraic convergence diagnostics, not bounds on global displacement error or physiological accuracy.
construction.appliedChange: Add only the solved-minus-original pucker scalar along the current native mouth x direction. Preserve native forward, up, funnel, stretch, R05 ownership, closure and later stages. No rest-shape smoothing.

requiredEvidence: Actual full-native 49 contact pairs exact on/off.
Protected core, one ring and central points directly exact; all-active exact is deliberately replaced because peripheral active points are the intended recipients.
At pucker=0 direct original R05 call; captured neutral, jaw and speaking complete state and pixels exact.
Same frozen original material, actual shader/uniforms, canonical arrays, topology, camera and lights.
Same complete-person save/restore and actual inherited mode regression gates.
One unchanged bounded image matrix; actual native-size corner improvement without new dimples, bulges or loss of motion.
Strict original request/resource error gates, with added native transport evidence if a request fails.
failureConditions: Visible improvement is obtained by weakening core pucker or changing contact trajectories.
New boundary folds, stretched patches, bulges or dimples.
Numerical field fails convergence, finite or range checks.
Any native state, original material, archive or public-browser gate fails.
limits: Displacement-field regularization is an engineering construction, not measured biomechanics or a contact/volume solve.
One frozen person and selected poses do not certify all identities or combined actions.
Thin lip edges, waxy appearance and oral detail remain separate work.
